name: COUPDAYSNC
description: COUPDAYSNC returns the number of days between settlement and the next coupon payment for a bond.
tldr: Calculates the number of days from the settlement date to the next coupon date.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: Number of coupon payments per year (1, 2, or 4).

basicExample.explanation: For a semi-annual bond purchased on April 1, 2024, this returns the days until the next coupon payment.

howItWorks: COUPDAYSNC is used to determine how many days remain until the next coupon payment, which affects the clean vs. dirty price of a bond.

howToSteps.name: Calculate
howToSteps.text: Press Enter to get the result.

commonErrors.fix: Use DATE function or valid date serial numbers.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: COUPDAYSNC works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the difference between COUPDAYSNC and COUPDAYBS?
faq.answer: COUPDAYSNC counts days from settlement to the next coupon. COUPDAYBS counts days from the coupon start to settlement.

faq.question: How is COUPDAYSNC used in bond pricing?
faq.answer: It helps determine the accrued interest and the dirty price of a bond.
